financial_semantic_pairs.trend_vs_momentum: directional structure is not strength or speed
financial_semantic_pairs.volatility_vs_direction: magnitude of movement does not imply up or down
financial_semantic_pairs.level_vs_target: reference level is not automatically a conditional objective
financial_semantic_pairs.signal_vs_confirmation: one observation is not confirmation unless the source says so
financial_semantic_pairs.actual_forecast_previous: keep each economic-data comparison base distinct
financial_semantic_pairs.scenario_vs_recommendation: conditional scenario is not trading advice
financial_semantic_pairs.invalidation_vs_stop_loss: view invalidation is not automatically an execution stop
